newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices back to gains, easing arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices back to gains, easing arrivals.

text.p: Indian sugar prices were back to gains on Wednesday on fresh consumer buying and easing arrivals, dealers said.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by 15 rupees at 1,250/1,280 rupees per quintal while M-30 moved up by 10 rupees at 1,275/1,350 rupees per quintal.
"Fresh arrivals remained low today as most of the delivery tenders out of the free sale quota for current month are exhausted and offerings by the millers remained at low ebb," one dealer said.
Overall sentiment was firm at the close but trading volumes remained low and were expected to remain low ahead of Friday's government budget.
